{"id":"mimid-08mr","title":"README's crate table is four crates short and two rows stale","description":"Found during the prose pass over the docs (Mark 2026-11-27: 'all the human readable text docs in mimid need the same treatment'). The deslop pass is prose only, so the content gaps were left.

MISSING from the Crates table, all four of which exist in crates/: mls-didwebvh, mimid-live, mimid-telemetry and mimid-agent-irc. mimid-agent-irc is the oddest, since the same README documents the [irc] front end further down. mimid-telemetry is new as of the telemetry work and went into AGENTS.md's crate map but not here.

STALE rows: mimid-agent-core says the agent reaches its server 'through their mimid server JMAP API', leaving out binding = stream and the live stream; mimid-agent says it serves a local JMAP Chat endpoint on loopback, leaving out the IRC front end and listen_tls, both of which the same README describes later.
